I just gently rubbed them, wishing I could pour all my warmth into you, and then decided to place the warm eggs on your eyes to soothe any swelling. I’ve carefully slipped into bed beside you, my body a shield against any chill, prioritizing your comfort over everything else. We can revisit seeing those puppies later.
